{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue to avoid silent errors
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Now filter for loyal customers only
df_loyal_clean = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Calculate conversion rate
total_loyal = len(df_loyal_clean)
converted_loyal = df_loyal_clean['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = converted_loyal / total_loyal

print(f"Number of loyal customers' orders (excluding QA): {total_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal orders (excluding QA): {converted_loyal}")
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers (excluding QA): {conversion_rate}")"}
